column1: # mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS LinkML classes and STIX 2.1 Domain Objects. Enables export of ISMS incident records as STIX bundles for TAXII sharing, and enrichment of risk records from incoming threat intelligence.

column10: STIX 2.1 Incident object aligns with ISMS incident record
Security event corresponds to STIX sighting of observable
Risk involves threat actor exploiting vulnerability
Annex A control aligns with STIX course-of-action object
ISMS asset corresponds to STIX infrastructure object
Applicable threats reference STIX attack patterns
Vulnerability description aligns with STIX vulnerability object
Malware category corresponds to STIX Malware SDO
Ransomware is a malware sub-type in STIX
Collected evidence as STIX observed data
